# Every blob-store call outside blobs.py (tests/test_fetch_sites.py): <file> <function> <method>, then why.
# CALLER: a name a request supplied, which passes blobs.own_key first. Every other line: INTERNAL, a key the relay
# builds from what it owns (the agency workspace, a job id, a hash it computed, a URL already checked at the door by
# Relay._check_urls). Add a line, with its kind, for each new call.

# library.py publish exists: CALLER, a ref the request names: own_key first (the one check)
# library.py publish key_for_url: CALLER, replaced by own_key
# service.py upload exists: CALLER, in/<the request sha>: own_key first, the hold decides what is said
# service.py upload presign_put: CALLER, in/<the request sha>: own_key first
# service.py _stored_clip_seconds clip_seconds: CALLER, the request video: clip_seconds goes through own_key
# service.py _own fetch_own: CALLER, fetch_own goes through own_key
# cards.py _make fetch_own: CALLER, fetch_own goes through own_key
# local.py do_PUT accept_upload: CALLER, local dev server only: the PUT path a presigned URL names, bound to its hash
